Objectives

Open your objectives to review the next step.

The journal keeps conversations. The message log keeps recent notices.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Quests and objectives

To progress in the game you'll have to complete many different quests - some are necessary and some are optional. These quests give your character additional experience and other benefits.

When you receive a new quest you'll hear a sound and see a message in the Text window. Detailed information will also be available in the Quests screen - see the next tutorial screen for more on this.

Text window

When you receive and complete a quest, messages appear in the Text window (currently highlighted). These messages describe the objectives of the quest and other information.

To open/close the Text window use the triangle button (currently highlighted) at the top of the text window.

Quests screen

Information about your quests is shown in the "Quests Screen". Typically, each quest includes several missions and objectives. Some of these will be shown immediately, while others will appear only after you complete previous missions. It's not always necessary to complete all objectives in order to complete the quest successfully.

To call up the Quests screen use the <TAB> key or click on the (currently highlighted) scroll icon in the lower-right corner. To return to the Game zone screen click on the button at the bottom of the Quests screen or press the <TAB> key again.

Note: if the scroll icon is flickering during the game it means you have received a new quest or objective, and the Quests screen has new information for you to read. Ignore at your peril.
